# Prometheus Service
[API index](index.md) | [Definition schema](schema.md)
| Field | Value |
| --- | --- |
| ID | `docker.prometheus.service` |
| Source | `09_docker/docker.prometheus.service.yaml` |
| Tags | docker, observability |
Prometheus metrics server scraping local fabric services. Loads its scrape config
from ./config/prometheus.yml and persists TSDB data on DATA_PATH.
